test_name: Verify Navigation to Privacy Policy from Login Page
description: This test ensures users can navigate to the Privacy Policy page from the login page and return back without issues.
steps: Scroll to the footer section of the page.
Locate the Privacy Policy link using the stable selector.
Click on the Privacy Policy link.
Ensure the browser navigates to https://roost.ai/privacy-policy.
Verify the contents of the Privacy Policy page are loaded.
Locate the 'Back' button in the browser and click it.
Ensure the browser navigates back to the login page.
expected_results: The user is redirected to the Privacy Policy page.
The Privacy Policy page content is displayed correctly.
The user can navigate back to the login page using the browser's back button.
edge_cases: Privacy Policy page fails to load.
Network issues while navigating to the Privacy Policy page.
The back button does not return the user to the login page.
Broken or incorrect link in the footer.
User navigates to an incorrect URL.
data_requirements: Privacy Policy link must be configured correctly.
Valid HTML content for the Privacy Policy page.
dependencies: The Privacy Policy page must be active and functional.
The footer section must be correctly implemented.
The login page must be accessible.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Privacy Policy page.
Time taken to navigate back to the login page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Privacy Policy link is keyboard navigable.
Verify proper ARIA roles and labels for the link.
Check for color contrast compliance on the link.
